explanation.bottleneck: The original round-robin feedback path can traverse request masking, priority encoding, index arithmetic and variable shifting before reaching mask_reg. Its one-hot grant path also decodes the encoded winner. These are structural timing risks; no timing report was supplied to establish the actual critical path.
explanation.area_or_other_cost: The prefix networks add combinational logic alongside the retained binary encoders, while removing their used one-hot decoders and the variable mask shifters. No registers or pipeline stages are added. Net mapped area, routing cost and compliance with the 4880.43072 um2 cap remain unmeasured.
explanation.rewrite: Keep the frozen priority_encoder instances for valid and binary index generation. Compute one-hot winners and next round-robin masks directly with parallel priority-direction OR prefixes. For MSB-first arbitration, each strict-prefix bit indicates whether any higher-numbered request exists; for LSB-first arbitration it indicates whether any lower-numbered request exists. This strict prefix is exactly the mask following the winning request, and request AND NOT strict-prefix is exactly its one-hot grant. Preserve the original blocking, hold, idle and synchronous reset decisions.
explanation.expected_timing_gain: Unmeasured. For PORTS=32, each prefix network has five constant-shift OR stages. The rewrite removes binary-index arithmetic and variable shifting from mask generation, and binary-to-one-hot decoding from grant generation. It is expected to shorten those feedback paths, but setup WNS improvement must be established by EDA at the fixed settings.
explanation.functional_boundaries: Preserves top name, parameter names/defaults, native port widths and signedness, existing register initialization semantics, single positive-edge clock, synchronous active-high reset, and output latency. Blocking and mask-update conditions remain unchanged, including resets after startup. Prefix identities support arbitrary simultaneous request bits and do not assume one-hot requests or acknowledges. The frozen dependency is instantiated, not redefined. No additional startup assumptions are introduced. Formal equivalence against the original frozen RTL and timing/area validation are still required.
output_format_normalization: Removed complete leading think wrapper before JSON parsing
